summary.name: Cohere
summary.one_liner: Cohere is an enterprise AI company offering North, an agentic AI platform, plus its own generative AI, search and multilingual models that enterprises can deploy and control.
keywords: ai knowledge search for company data
use_cases: Build internal copilots over company data
Automate outage triage and compliance reporting for utilities
Automate CI to deployment release workflows
Run private, isolated AI model inference
summary.what_it_does: The page presents North by Cohere as an agentic enterprise AI platform that customers can own and deploy on their own terms. It describes Cohere Models as tools for generative AI, advanced search and multilingual tasks. Model Vault is described as providing fully isolated inference with end-to-end encryption. The page also lists industry solution areas such as finance, government, software development and energy/utilities, with example workflows for each. It states that the platform and models meet security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy standards, but gives no technical detail on how these are implemented.
notable: North: an ownable, deployable agentic AI platform
Model Vault: isolated inference with end-to-end encryption
Cohere Models for generative AI, advanced search and multilingual use
Industry-specific solution pages (finance, government, software, energy)
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it freemium, which the page itself does not confirm.
Page is mostly marketing; no concrete technical specs, deployment options or limits are given.
